sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，可能不适合所有听众。

sentences.en: The Northwest Providence Channel is a body of water that sits between the two banks that make up most of the Bahama Archipelago.
sentences.zh: 西北普罗维登斯海峡是一片位于巴哈马群岛大部分区域两侧之间的水域。

sentences.en: To the west of the channel is the Gulf Stream, an ocean current that flows through the Straits of Florida and up along the east coast of the United States.
sentences.zh: 海峡以西是墨西哥湾流，这是一股流经佛罗里达海峡并沿美国东海岸北上的洋流。

sentences.en: On Monday, November 13, 1961, a 21,000 tonne oil tanker called the Gulf Lion entered the Northwest Providence Channel
sentences.zh: 1961年11月13日星期一，一艘名为“海湾狮号”的21000吨油轮进入了西北普罗维登斯海峡，

sentences.en: after departing the Florida city of Fort Lauderdale, headed for San Juan, Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 它从佛罗里达州的劳德代尔堡出发，目的地是波多黎各的圣胡安。

sentences.en: At noon that day, one of the crew members assumed the role of the tanker's lookout at the stern.
sentences.zh: 当天中午，一名船员在船尾担任瞭望员。

sentences.en: About 30 minutes into his four-hour shift, he noticed something bobbing in the choppy water about four miles away.
sentences.zh: 在他四小时轮班开始约30分钟后，他注意到四英里外波涛汹涌的水面上有什么东西在起伏。

sentences.en: It was a white wooden dinghy with its sails furled.
sentences.zh: 那是一艘收起风帆的白色木制小艇。

sentences.en: Inside the small boat was a lone man.
sentences.zh: 小艇里坐着一名孤身男子。

sentences.en: 40-year-old doctor Arthur Duperold had long wanted to take his family on a special vacation.
sentences.zh: 40岁的医生亚瑟·杜佩罗一直想带家人去度一次特别的假期。

sentences.en: A successful contact lens optometrist who resided in Green Bay, Wisconsin, Arthur had previously served in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟是一位居住在威斯康星州绿湾的成功隐形眼镜验光师，他曾在美国海军服役。

sentences.en: Navy.
sentences.zh: 海军。

sentences.en: On his way to serve in Myanmar during World War II, he had sailed across the Pacific Ocean and developed a deep love of the sea and the tropics.
sentences.zh: 二战期间，他在前往缅甸服役的途中航行穿过了太平洋，从此对海洋和热带地区产生了深厚的感情。

sentences.en: The climate was far warmer than in his home state of Wisconsin, and the expansive Pacific was far greater than any body of water he'd seen before.
sentences.zh: 那里的气候比他的家乡威斯康星州温暖得多，广阔的太平洋也比他以前见过的任何水域都要壮丽。

sentences.en: After completing his military service, Arthur met a woman two years his junior named Jean Brosh.
sentences.zh: 退役后，亚瑟遇到了一位比他小两岁的女性，名叫简·布罗什。

sentences.en: The two had a whirlwind romance and married shortly after meeting.
sentences.zh: 两人坠入爱河，闪电结婚。

sentences.en: The couple soon had three children, a son named Brian and two daughters, Terry Jo and Renee.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇很快有了三个孩子，一个儿子叫布莱恩，两个女儿分别叫特里·乔和蕾妮。

sentences.en: Over the following years, Arthur often dreamt of showing his family the tropic waters that he'd loved so much.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，亚瑟经常梦想着带家人去看看他深爱的热带海域。

sentences.en: By late 1961, that dream finally became a reality.
sentences.zh: 到1961年底，这个梦想终于成为了现实。

sentences.en: Arthur and Jean had saved their money and planned to escape Wisconsin's cold winter for a sailing adventure.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟和简攒够了钱，计划逃离威斯康星州的寒冬，去进行一次航海探险。

sentences.en: It would start with a week-long cruise in the Bahamas, and if that went well, the family would take a year-long sabbatical together.
sentences.zh: 行程将从巴哈马为期一周的巡游开始，如果一切顺利，全家人将一起休一年的长假。

sentences.en: In early November 1961, the Duperold family road tripped down to Florida and began looking for the right boat to charter at the city's Bahia Mar Marina.
sentences.zh: 1961年11月初，杜佩罗一家开车南下佛罗里达，开始在当地的巴伊亚马尔码头寻找合适的租赁船只。

sentences.en: Arthur Duperold inspected a number of boats docked at the marina before discovering the Bluebell,
sentences.zh: 亚瑟·杜佩罗在码头检查了多艘船只，最终发现了“蓝铃号”，

sentences.en: a two-mastered sailboat known as a catch that had originally been built as a racing yacht.
sentences.zh: 这是一艘双桅帆船，最初是作为赛艇建造的。

sentences.en: It was 60 feet long and 15 feet across at its widest point.
sentences.zh: 它全长60英尺，最宽处为15英尺。

sentences.en: It also had a wooden dinghy and black rubber life raft.
sentences.zh: 船上还配有一艘木制小艇和一个黑色橡胶救生筏。

sentences.en: Inside, the boat's main cabin was 13 feet long, with three portholes on either side and a skylight.
sentences.zh: 船内主舱长13英尺，两侧各有三个舷窗，顶部有一个天窗。

sentences.en: The cabin contained a dining area with comfortable seating, a small bathroom and a kitchenette.
sentences.zh: 舱内设有一个带舒适座椅的用餐区、一个小浴室和一个小厨房。

sentences.en: In front of the cabin was a main bedroom with a queen-sized bed.
sentences.zh: 主舱前方是配有一张大床的主卧室。

sentences.en: Another small sleeping area sat at the cabin's rear.
sentences.zh: 舱尾还有另一个小睡眠区。

sentences.en: These would be the family's quarters.
sentences.zh: 这些就是家人的居住空间。

sentences.en: Finally, there was a forward cabin tucked in front of the main bedroom, designed to house the boat's crew.
sentences.zh: 最后，主卧室前方还有一个专为船员设计的船头舱。

sentences.en: Bluebell was the perfect size for the Duperold family.
sentences.zh: “蓝铃号”的大小对杜佩罗一家来说非常完美。

sentences.en: Arthur found out it was owned by a man named Harold Pegg and skippered by a 44-year-old former Air Force pilot called Julian Harvey.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟发现船主是一个叫哈罗德·佩格的人，船长是44岁的前空军飞行员朱利安·哈维。

sentences.en: Harold agreed to allow the Duperolts to charter Bluebell for $100 per day.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德同意以每天100美元的价格将“蓝铃号”租给杜佩罗一家。

sentences.en: While the Duperolts would help out here and there with some minor running and steering of the sailboat,
sentences.zh: 虽然杜佩罗一家会帮忙做些轻微的航行和掌舵工作，

sentences.en: Captain Julian Harvey would take the helm as their skipper.
sentences.zh: 但朱利安·哈维船长将作为他们的船长掌舵。

sentences.en: Captain Harvey had recently married just three months earlier, and his wife Mary, who was 34, would be the family's cook.
sentences.zh: 哈维船长三个月前刚结婚，他34岁的妻子玛丽将担任全家的厨师。

sentences.en: By the afternoon of Wednesday November 8, the group was ready to set sail.
sentences.zh: 11月8日星期三下午，一行人准备启航。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, the Duperolts and their crew spent their time cruising across the sea.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天里，杜佩罗一家和船员们在海上航行。

sentences.en: They observed pelicans soaring through the sky, watched porpoises swim alongside their boat, and even spotted a giant sea turtle floating nearby.
sentences.zh: 他们观察着在天空中翱翔的鹈鹕，看着海豚在船边游动，甚至还发现了附近漂浮着一只巨大的海龟。

sentences.en: The children got a thrill when they saw a shark fin surface at one point.
sentences.zh: 当孩子们看到鲨鱼鳍浮出水面时，感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: The family also visited a number of the Bahamas islands, most of which were tiny and uninhabited.
sentences.zh: 全家人还参观了巴哈马群岛的许多岛屿，其中大多数都很小且无人居住。

sentences.en: All strong swimmers, the family went snorkelling and spearfishing.
sentences.zh: 全家人游泳技术都很好，他们去浮潜和用鱼叉捕鱼。

sentences.en: Sometimes Arthur went out in the dinghy with 14-year-old Brian and 11-year-old Terry Jo, and they would explore the coral reefs.
sentences.zh: 有时亚瑟会带着14岁的布莱恩和11岁的特里·乔乘小艇出去探索珊瑚礁。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Jean Duperolts stayed on the beach with their youngest child, 7-year-old Renee, collecting shells and digging in the sand.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，简·杜佩罗则带着最小的孩子、7岁的蕾妮留在沙滩上捡贝壳和挖沙子。

sentences.en: Brian had brought a .22 calibre rifle along with the intention of possibly hunting sharks, but didn't end up using it.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩带了一支.22口径的步枪，打算用来猎鲨，但最终没用上。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Captain Harvey focused on the running of the ship, picking up supplies and assisting in filing paperwork that allowed the family to move freely through the Bahamas.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，哈维船长专注于航行，负责补给物资并协助办理让全家在巴哈马自由通行的文书工作。

sentences.en: His wife Mary didn't find the voyage as carefree as the Duperolts did.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子玛丽并不觉得这次航行像杜佩罗一家那样无忧无虑。

sentences.en: In a letter she sent home to her mother, she complained about never having a moment to herself, writing,
sentences.zh: 在写给母亲的信中，她抱怨说从没有属于自己的时间，写道：

sentences.en: I think I'll devise some kind of disappearing act.
sentences.zh: “我想我得想办法玩个失踪。”

sentences.en: Why oh why can't people leave me alone?
sentences.zh: “为什么人们就不能让我一个人待着呢？”

sentences.en: But aside from this minor complaint, Mary seemed up a beat, telling her mother the Duperolts were lovely people and their children were well behaved.
sentences.zh: 但除了这点小抱怨，玛丽看起来心情不错，她告诉母亲杜佩罗一家人很好，孩子们也很有礼貌。

sentences.en: A few days into the trip, Captain Harvey anchored the Bluebell in the harbour of Sandy Point, a small fishing town in the Great Abaco Bahamas.
sentences.zh: 航行几天后，哈维船长将“蓝铃号”停泊在巴哈马大阿巴科岛的一个小渔镇——桑迪角。

sentences.en: Over the course of a weekend, the Duperolts explored the village and chatted to locals, with Arthur Duperolts telling the village commissioner,
sentences.zh: 周末期间，杜佩罗一家在村里游玩并与当地人交谈，亚瑟·杜佩罗对村专员说：

sentences.en: This has been a once-in-a-lifetime vacation.
sentences.zh: “这是一次一生难得的假期。”

sentences.en: We are going to come back and use Sandy Point as a winter resort.
sentences.zh: “我们以后还会回来，把桑迪角当作冬季度假胜地。”

sentences.en: On Sunday November 12, Captain Harvey and his wife Mary headed to the commissioner's office
sentences.zh: 11月12日星期日，哈维船长和妻子玛丽前往专员办公室，

sentences.en: to file the family's leaving papers, as they would be beginning their journey back to Florida that night.
sentences.zh: 办理全家的离境手续，因为他们当晚就要开始返回佛罗里达的旅程。

sentences.en: It was a 200-mile journey, which Captain Harvey and Arthur Duperolts planned to cover in two days by sailing almost constantly.
sentences.zh: 这是一段200英里的航程，哈维船长和亚瑟·杜佩罗计划通过几乎不间断的航行在两天内完成。

sentences.en: They chatted and joked with the commissioner and his wife.
sentences.zh: 他们与专员夫妇聊天开玩笑。

sentences.en: Mary told them that the Duperolts had already decided to charter the Bluebell again before Christmas, so they would all be back very soon.
sentences.zh: 玛丽告诉他们，杜佩罗一家已经决定在圣诞节前再次租用“蓝铃号”，所以他们很快就会回来。

sentences.en: At 12.35pm the following day of Monday November 13,
sentences.zh: 次日，即11月13日星期一中午12点35分，

sentences.en: a crew member on board the oil tanker Gulf Lion spotted a small, white dinghy bobbing in the choppy waters of the northwest Providence Channel.
sentences.zh: 油轮“海湾狮号”上的一名船员在西北普罗维登斯海峡波涛汹涌的水面上发现了一艘白色小艇在起伏。

sentences.en: The figure of a man was visible inside the dinghy.
sentences.zh: 可以看到小艇里有一个人的身影。

sentences.en: As the dinghy was behind the tanker, they had to turn around to head towards it.
sentences.zh: 由于小艇在油轮后方，他们不得不掉头向它驶去。

sentences.en: As the Gulf Lion drew closer, its crew members saw the man stand and start to wave his arms, as though trying to get their attention.
sentences.zh: 当“海湾狮号”靠近时，船员们看到那名男子站起来开始挥动手臂，似乎在试图引起他们的注意。

sentences.en: He appeared to have something in his arms, like a tarpaulin or life jacket, that he used to gesture with.
sentences.zh: 他手里似乎拿着什么东西，像是一块防水布或救生衣，用来挥舞示意。

sentences.en: They could also make out a black rubber life raft tied alongside the dinghy with something inside, though they couldn't see what the object was.
sentences.zh: 他们还能辨认出小艇旁系着一个黑色橡胶救生筏，里面有东西，但看不清是什么。

sentences.en: Finally, after about 30 minutes, the tanker reached the dinghy.
sentences.zh: 最终，在大约30分钟后，油轮到达了小艇旁。

sentences.en: The man inside looked to be in his 40s and was tall with bare feet and sun-bleached hair.
sentences.zh: 艇内的男子看起来40多岁，身材高大，赤着脚，头发被阳光晒成了浅色。

sentences.en: Stammering slightly, he called out,
sentences.zh: 他结结巴巴地喊道：

sentences.en: My name is Julian Harvey.
sentences.zh: “我叫朱利安·哈维。”

sentences.en: I am master of the Bluebell.
sentences.zh: “我是‘蓝铃号’的船长。”

sentences.en: I have a dead baby on this dinghy.
sentences.zh: “我的小艇上有一个死婴。”

sentences.en: It wasn't until the Gulf Lion had reached the dinghy that its crew members could finally see the object inside the life raft.
sentences.zh: 直到“海湾狮号”靠近小艇，船员们才终于看清救生筏里的东西。

sentences.en: It was the body of 7-year-old Renée Duperold.
sentences.zh: 那是7岁蕾妮·杜佩罗的遗体。

sentences.en: The sight of the little girl's body left the Gulf Lion's crew members feeling sick.
sentences.zh: 看到小女孩的遗体，油轮船员们感到一阵恶心。

sentences.en: Renée appeared stiff and blue and was clearly deceased.
sentences.zh: 蕾妮看起来身体僵硬，脸色发青，显然已经死亡。

sentences.en: They lowered a basket to retrieve her body.
sentences.zh: 他们放下吊篮将她的遗体打捞上来。

sentences.en: After Renée was safely aboard the oil tanker, Captain Harvey clambered up a rope ladder to the Gulf Lion's deck, where crew members gathered around him.
sentences.zh: 蕾妮被安全带上油轮后，哈维船长顺着绳梯爬上了“海湾狮号”的甲板，船员们围在他身边。

sentences.en: They provided him with food and treated him for mild shock.
sentences.zh: 他们给他提供了食物，并对他进行了轻度休克的治疗。

sentences.en: Harvey appeared dazed as he was approached by the Gulf Lion's captain, who asked him what had happened.
sentences.zh: 当“海湾狮号”的船长走过来询问发生了什么事时，哈维显得神情恍惚。

sentences.en: Harvey explained that just before midnight the previous night, the Bluebell had been sailing smoothly when it was suddenly caught up in a sharp gust of wind, known as a squall.
sentences.zh: 哈维解释说，前一天午夜前，“蓝铃号”航行平稳，突然遭遇了一阵强风，也就是飑。

sentences.en: This resulted in the catcher's main mast snapping in two.
sentences.zh: 这导致双桅帆船的主桅杆断成了两截。

sentences.en: A 50-foot portion of the mast plunged down, driving a huge hole into the Bluebell's deck and hole.
sentences.zh: 一段50英尺长的桅杆坠落，在“蓝铃号”的甲板和船体上砸出了一个大洞。

sentences.en: As the main mast fell, it pulled the other mast down too, which fell into the cockpit over the engine room.
sentences.zh: 主桅杆倒下时，也带倒了另一根桅杆，它落在了机舱上方的驾驶舱里。

sentences.en: Most of the Bluebell's passengers were gathered in the cockpit at the time and were now trapped by the mast's cables and rigging.
sentences.zh: 当时“蓝铃号”的大多数乘客都聚集在驾驶舱，被桅杆的缆绳和索具困住了。

sentences.en: Captain Harvey ran below deck to fetch some cable cutters he could use to free the other passengers from the debris.
sentences.zh: 哈维船长跑下甲板去拿钢缆剪，想用它把其他乘客从残骸中解救出来。

sentences.en: When he returned with them, he saw a fire raging.
sentences.zh: 当他带着剪刀回来时，看到火势正猛。

sentences.en: The second mast's fall had ruptured fuel lines in the engine room, resulting in enormous flames.
sentences.zh: 第二根桅杆的倒塌弄断了机舱里的燃油管，引发了巨大的火焰。

sentences.en: The fire enveloped the cockpit and spread across the deck, which had recently been painted with highly flammable neoprene.
sentences.zh: 大火吞没了驾驶舱，并蔓延到甲板上，而甲板最近刚涂过高度易燃的氯丁橡胶。

sentences.en: Simultaneously, the catch had started to sink.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这艘帆船开始下沉。

sentences.en: Harvey returned below deck once again to grab a fire extinguisher, then tried to douse the flames, but they were too strong.
sentences.zh: 哈维再次回到甲板下拿灭火器，试图扑灭火焰，但火势太猛了。

sentences.en: Cut off from the other passengers by the blaze, Harvey decided to launch the dinghy and attempt to reach them by water instead.
sentences.zh: 由于大火阻断了通往其他乘客的道路，哈维决定放下小艇，试图从水路接近他们。

sentences.en: He used the cable cutters to cut through a guardrail and release a life raft, then pushed the 10-foot-long dinghy into the water.
sentences.zh: 他用钢缆剪剪断护栏，释放了一个救生筏，然后将10英尺长的小艇推入水中。

sentences.en: As he paddled towards the Bluebell's stern, the catch began to sink faster, slipping below the rough waters.
sentences.zh: 当他划向“蓝铃号”船尾时，帆船开始加速下沉，滑入汹涌的水中。

sentences.en: Captain Harvey navigated through the dark sea as best as he could, calling out to his wife Mary and the Duperault family.
sentences.zh: 哈维船长尽其所能穿过黑暗的海面，呼喊着他的妻子玛丽和杜佩罗一家。

sentences.en: But no one called back to him.
sentences.zh: 但没有人回应他。

sentences.en: The only passenger he was able to find was seven-year-old Renee Duperault, who floated by him wearing a life preserver.
sentences.zh: 他唯一能找到的乘客是7岁的蕾妮·杜佩罗，她穿着救生衣漂浮在他身边。

sentences.en: When he pulled her into the life raft, she was already dead.
sentences.zh: 当他把她拉上救生筏时，她已经死了。

sentences.zh: Case File稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Case File继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: The Gulf Lion's captain radioed the US Coast Guard to alert them of the tragedy, and an air and sea search was launched to look for any possible survivors.
sentences.zh: “海湾狮号”船长通过无线电向美国海岸警卫队报告了这起悲剧，随后展开了海空搜救，寻找任何可能的幸存者。

sentences.en: Two rescue planes and two Coast Guard cutters were dispatched, and messages were sent to ships in the area.
sentences.zh: 两架救援飞机和两艘海岸警卫队巡逻艇被派出，并向该地区的船只发送了消息。

sentences.en: Yet, no survivors were found.
sentences.zh: 然而，没有发现任何幸存者。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Gulf Lion detoured to Nassau, the largest city in the Bahamas situated about 60 miles south of their current location, to drop off Harvey.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，“海湾狮号”绕道前往巴哈马最大的城市拿骚，该市位于他们当前位置以南约60英里处，以便让哈维下船。

sentences.en: Miraculously, the Bluebells' captain was uninjured and unharmed, but he had still suffered a severe trauma.
sentences.zh: 奇迹般的是，“蓝铃号”的船长没有受伤，安然无恙，但他仍然遭受了严重的创伤。

sentences.en: The Gulf Lion's crew rallied together to raise $180 to give to Harvey.
sentences.zh: “海湾狮号”的船员们齐心协力筹集了180美元交给哈维。

sentences.en: He used the collection to fly home to the United States, boarding a flight to Miami on Tuesday, November 14.
sentences.zh: 他用这笔钱飞回美国，于11月14日星期二登上了飞往迈阿密的航班。

sentences.en: Upon landing in Miami, Captain Harvey phoned the Coast Guard to check in with them.
sentences.zh: 抵达迈阿密后，哈维船长致电海岸警卫队进行报备。

sentences.en: They asked Harvey to attend an informal hearing in two days' time so he could describe the events surrounding the Bluebells' sinking in more detail.
sentences.zh: 他们要求哈维在两天后参加一场非正式听证会，以便他能更详细地描述“蓝铃号”沉没前后的事件。

sentences.en: Harvey readily agreed and presented at the Coast Guard's Miami headquarters at 9am on Thursday, November 16.
sentences.zh: 哈维欣然同意，并于11月16日星期四上午9点出现在海岸警卫队迈阿密总部。

sentences.en: Also in attendance was Harold Pegg, the owner of the Bluebell, Pegg's attorney, and investigating officer Lieutenant Ernest Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 出席会议的还有“蓝铃号”船主哈罗德·佩格、佩格的律师以及调查官欧内斯特·默多克中尉。

sentences.en: Before the hearing got underway, Harvey asked Lieutenant Murdoch whether there was any update in the search for the Bluebells' passengers.
sentences.zh: 听证会开始前，哈维询问默多克中尉关于“蓝铃号”乘客的搜救是否有任何进展。

sentences.en: He was informed that not only had the two searchplanes and two Coast Guard cutters failed to find any who'd been on board the Bluebell,
sentences.zh: 他被告知，不仅两架搜救飞机和两艘海岸警卫队巡逻艇没能找到任何船上人员，

sentences.en: but they hadn't even recovered any debris from the catch.
sentences.zh: 甚至连帆船的任何残骸都没打捞到。

sentences.en: Captain Harvey began recounting what happened by explaining that the Bluebell had departed Sandy Point shortly after dark on the evening of Sunday, November 12.
sentences.zh: 哈维船长开始叙述经过，解释说“蓝铃号”是在11月12日星期日傍晚天黑后不久离开桑迪角的。

sentences.en: The weather had been pleasant and calm, prompting all of the passengers to stay up in the cockpit.
sentences.zh: 天气一直很宜人平静，促使所有乘客都待在驾驶舱里。

sentences.en: The adults chatted while the duper old children napped.
sentences.zh: 大人们在聊天，而杜佩罗家的孩子们在打盹。

sentences.en: Captain Harvey was steering the boat.
sentences.zh: 哈维船长当时正在掌舵。

sentences.en: However, there were a few small rain squalls in the area and the Bluebell suddenly encountered one of these shortly before midnight.
sentences.zh: 然而，该地区有几阵小雨飑，“蓝铃号”在午夜前不久突然遭遇了其中一阵。

sentences.en: Harvey explained how this had broken the masts and severely damaged the boat.
sentences.zh: 哈维解释了这如何折断了桅杆并严重损坏了船只。

sentences.en: Some suffered injuries caused by the mast falling.
sentences.zh: 一些人因桅杆倒塌而受伤。

sentences.en: Harvey's wife, Mary, and Arthur Duperolt both had their legs cut by splinters of wood.
sentences.zh: 哈维的妻子玛丽和亚瑟·杜佩罗的腿都被木屑割伤了。

sentences.en: The accident caused 11-year-old Terry Jo Duperolt to start screaming and Harvey had tried to calm her down.
sentences.zh: 事故导致11岁的特里·乔·杜佩罗开始尖叫，哈维试图让她冷静下来。

sentences.en: He stammered as he spoke and his jaw trembled.
sentences.zh: 他说话时结结巴巴，下巴颤抖。

sentences.en: It was clear he was struggling at times to find the right words to describe the tragedy.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他有时难以找到合适的词汇来描述这场悲剧。

sentences.en: Sometimes he shifted in his seat and ran his hands through his hair.
sentences.zh: 他有时在座位上挪动，用手抓着头发。

sentences.en: Everyone present could see how much stress he was under.
sentences.zh: 在场的所有人都看得出他承受着多大的压力。

sentences.en: Harvey continued on, describing the fire and how the catch started to sink.
sentences.zh: 哈维继续描述大火以及帆船如何开始下沉。

sentences.en: Harvey said that as he decided to launch the dinghy, the passengers cut off from him by the fire saw what he was doing and chose to jump overboard into the water.
sentences.zh: 哈维说，当他决定放下小艇时，被大火阻断的乘客看到了他的举动，选择跳入水中。

sentences.en: All three Duperolt children had been wearing life preservers at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时杜佩罗家的三个孩子都穿着救生衣。

sentences.en: There were also life rings nearby that the adults had access to.
sentences.zh: 附近还有大人们可以使用的救生圈。

sentences.en: They seemingly hoped to survive by escaping the flames and landing safely where Harvey could reach them.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎希望通过逃离火焰并安全着陆，让哈维能救到他们从而幸存下来。

sentences.en: As Harvey steered the dinghy into the sea, he could hear the others yelling out faintly.
sentences.zh: 当哈维驾驶小艇驶入海中时，他能听到其他人微弱的呼喊声。

sentences.en: But by the time he reached the stern they had leapt from, none were visible in the water.
sentences.zh: 但当他到达他们跳船的船尾时，水面上已经看不见任何人了。

sentences.en: The pitch black night made Harvey's rescue mission even harder as he struggled to see his surroundings with rain, wind, and waves pelting his face.
sentences.zh: 漆黑的夜晚让哈维的救援任务变得更加困难，雨水、风和海浪拍打着他的脸，他努力辨认周围的环境。

sentences.en: Harvey shouted to the others until his voice was hoarse.
sentences.zh: 哈维大声呼喊其他人，直到嗓音嘶哑。

sentences.en: No replies came.
sentences.zh: 没有任何回应。

sentences.en: The bluebell sank quietly into the sea, extinguishing the flames.
sentences.zh: “蓝铃号”静静地沉入海中，熄灭了火焰。

sentences.en: When Harvey finally came across the body of Renée Duperolt, he tried to resuscitate her, but she was already deceased.
sentences.zh: 当哈维最终发现蕾妮·杜佩罗特的遗体时，他试图进行心肺复苏，但她已经去世了。

sentences.en: Harvey tied her to the life raft so her remains would be safe.
sentences.zh: 哈维把她绑在救生筏上，以确保她的遗体安全。

sentences.en: The strenuous actions of launching the dinghy by himself, rowing it solo and searching for survivors, had left him exhausted.
sentences.zh: 独自放下小艇、划船并搜寻幸存者的繁重工作让他精疲力竭。

sentences.en: As the sun rose the next morning, he ate the emergency rations in the dinghy.
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨太阳升起时，他在小艇上吃了应急口粮。

sentences.en: The sun helped warm up the freezing Captain Harvey, though waves continued to drench him repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 阳光帮助冻僵的哈维船长暖和了一些，尽管海浪仍不断地拍打着他。

sentences.en: By early afternoon, he spotted the Gulf Lion oil tanker and was able to signal for rescue.
sentences.zh: 午后不久，他发现了“海湾狮子号”油轮，并成功发出了求救信号。

sentences.en: Lieutenant Murdoch asked Captain Harvey why he hadn't tried to use the bluebell's radio to call for help.
sentences.zh: 默多克中尉问哈维船长，为什么他没有尝试用“蓝铃号”的无线电呼救。

sentences.en: Harvey said he knew it wouldn't work as the main mast had taken out the antenna when it fell.
sentences.zh: 哈维说他知道无线电没用，因为主桅杆倒下时把天线也带断了。

sentences.en: Despite having flares in the emergency kit in the dinghy, it hadn't even occurred to him to use them.
sentences.zh: 尽管小艇的应急包里有信号弹，但他根本没想到要使用它们。

sentences.en: Plus, he explained, they were buried deep in the kit, making them hard to reach.
sentences.zh: 此外，他解释说，信号弹埋在应急包深处，很难拿取。

sentences.en: Finally, Lieutenant Murdoch concluded his questioning of Captain Julian Harvey and turned his attention to the Bluebell's owner, Harold Pegg.
sentences.zh: 最后，默多克中尉结束了对朱利安·哈维船长的盘问，转而询问“蓝铃号”的船主哈罗德·佩格。

sentences.en: Lieutenant Murdoch told Harvey he could stay to listen to his employer's testimony and would be allowed to ask questions if he disagreed with anything Harold Pegg said.
sentences.zh: 默多克中尉告诉哈维，他可以留下来听他雇主的证词，如果对哈罗德·佩格所说的任何内容有异议，他可以提出质疑。

sentences.en: A few moments later, the door to the hearing room burst open.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，听证室的门被猛地推开了。

sentences.en: Coast Guard Captain Robert Barber, who was handling the investigation alongside Lieutenant Murdoch, rushed in.
sentences.zh: 与默多克中尉共同负责调查的海岸警卫队罗伯特·巴伯船长冲了进来。

sentences.en: He had urgent news.
sentences.zh: 他带来了紧急消息。

sentences.en: Another survivor had been found.
sentences.zh: 又发现了一名幸存者。

sentences.en: On the morning of Thursday, November 16, Second Officer Nikolaus Spakadakis stared out at the water as his ship passed through the Northwest Providence Channel.
sentences.zh: 11月16日星期四上午，二副尼古拉斯·斯帕卡达基斯在船只经过西北普罗维登斯海峡时，凝视着海面。
zh_words: 副尼古拉斯·斯帕卡达基斯

sentences.en: The Captain Theo was a Greek freighter that was on its way to Houston, Texas, and Nikolaus was acting as watcher.
sentences.zh: “西奥船长号”是一艘希腊货轮，正前往德克萨斯州的休斯顿，尼古拉斯当时担任瞭望员。

sentences.en: Standing high up on the bridge, he spotted a few other ships in the distance.
sentences.zh: 他站在高高的驾驶台上，看到远处有几艘船。

sentences.en: The sun was shining brightly, making Nikolaus' job easier.
sentences.zh: 阳光明媚，让尼古拉斯的工作轻松了不少。

sentences.en: Thousands of whitecaps dotted the surface of the water, but while most ebbed and flowed with the waves, one did not.
sentences.zh: 海面上点缀着成千上万的白浪，但大多数随波逐流，唯独有一个没有。

sentences.en: The tiny white object caught Nikolaus' eye.
sentences.zh: 那个微小的白色物体引起了尼古拉斯的注意。

sentences.en: He stared at the object, squinting to get a better look.
sentences.zh: 他盯着那个物体，眯起眼睛仔细观察。

sentences.en: Nikolaus suspected it was a piece of debris, and then he spotted the outline of a person inside.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯怀疑那是一块碎片，接着他看到了里面有一个人的轮廓。

sentences.en: Initially, Nikolaus wondered if he was seeing a fisherman on a dinghy, before realising they were out way too far for that.
sentences.zh: 起初，尼古拉斯以为自己看到的是小艇上的渔民，但随即意识到这里离岸太远，不可能有渔民。

sentences.en: Nikolaus called over the ship's captain.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯叫来了船长。

sentences.en: By now, the object was about a mile away from the starboard bow of the freighter.
sentences.zh: 此时，那个物体距离货轮右舷大约一英里。

sentences.en: The ship slowly drew closer, and as it did so, Nikolaus and the captain realised they were looking at a tiny, rectangular-shaped life raft.
sentences.zh: 船只缓缓靠近，随着距离缩短，尼古拉斯和船长意识到他们看到的是一个微小的长方形救生筏。

sentences.en: It was two and a half feet by five feet, and made of canvas-covered cork with rope webbing in the middle.
sentences.zh: 它长五英尺、宽两英尺半，由帆布覆盖的软木制成，中间有绳网。

sentences.en: The person inside was a female child.
sentences.zh: 里面的人是一个女童。

sentences.en: She was sitting up but reclining slightly in a stiff, uncomfortable pose, her legs hanging over the life raft into the water.
sentences.zh: 她坐着，姿势僵硬且不舒服，身体微微后仰，双腿垂在救生筏外浸在水里。

sentences.en: Her hair was bleached blonde by the sun, and she wore a white blouse and pink pedal-pushes.
sentences.zh: 她的头发被阳光晒成了浅金色，穿着一件白色衬衫和粉色七分裤。

sentences.en: The girl waved weakly at the ship's crew, who were staring at her in shock.
sentences.zh: 女孩向船员们无力地挥了挥手，船员们正震惊地盯着她。

sentences.en: The captain ordered his crew to stop the engines.
sentences.zh: 船长下令停船。

sentences.en: Because the ship's lifeboats were large, he worried that lowering one down to the girl would knock her off the raft and into the water.
sentences.zh: 由于船上的救生艇很大，他担心放下救生艇会把女孩从筏子上撞落到水里。

sentences.en: So a makeshift raft was created from empty oil druMs.
sentences.zh: 于是，他们用空油桶制作了一个简易木筏。

sentences.en: The captain suddenly noticed something alarming.
sentences.zh: 船长突然注意到一件令人担忧的事。

sentences.en: The fins of several sharks were circling the girl's raft, and she was still sitting with her legs dangling in the water.
sentences.zh: 几条鲨鱼的背鳍正在女孩的救生筏周围盘旋，而她依然双腿垂在水里坐着。

sentences.en: He called for his crew to hurry up, and the oil drums were lowered over the side.
sentences.zh: 他大声催促船员快点，油桶被放到了船侧。

sentences.en: A crew member followed and picked up the little girl.
sentences.zh: 一名船员随后跳下水抱起了小女孩。

sentences.en: As soon as she was in his arms, she fell limp before being hoisted up to the ship's deck.
sentences.zh: 她一被抱住就瘫软了下来，随后被吊上了甲板。

sentences.en: It was clear she had been alone at sea for some time.
sentences.zh: 很明显，她已经在海上独自漂流了一段时间。

sentences.en: Her face was gaunt and sunburnt, her lips were swollen, and her eyes dazed and unfocused.
sentences.zh: 她的脸消瘦且晒伤，嘴唇肿胀，眼神呆滞且无法聚焦。

sentences.en: She was severely dehydrated and obviously in shock.
sentences.zh: 她严重脱水，显然处于休克状态。

sentences.en: Crew members carried the girl to a spare cabin and placed her on a bunk before bringing her water, orange juice, and damp towels.
sentences.zh: 船员们把女孩抱到一间空舱室，放在铺位上，然后拿来了水、橙汁和湿毛巾。

sentences.en: The captain asked the girl her name, explaining he would alert the coast guard so they could notify her family.
sentences.zh: 船长问女孩的名字，并解释说他会通知海岸警卫队，以便他们通知她的家人。

sentences.en: Wordlessly, the girl shook her head and pointed down with her thumb.
sentences.zh: 女孩一言不发，摇了摇头，用大拇指向下指了指。

sentences.en: The captain interpreted this as the girl saying her family had been lost in the same accident as her.
sentences.zh: 船长将其解读为女孩在说她的家人在和她遭遇的同一场事故中遇难了。

sentences.en: He tried to reassure her, stating, You can't be sure they are loSt.
sentences.zh: 他试图安慰她，说道：“你不能确定他们已经遇难了。”

sentences.en: Maybe some other ship saved them.
sentences.zh: “也许有别的船救了他们。”

sentences.en: The girl shook her head again and pointed at the water.
sentences.zh: 女孩又摇了摇头，指了指水面。

sentences.en: Then she said in a hoarse voice,
sentences.zh: 然后她用嘶哑的声音说道：

sentences.en: Bluebell, before telling the captain her name.
sentences.zh: “蓝铃号”，接着告诉了船长她的名字。

sentences.en: Terry Jo Duperolt.
sentences.zh: “特里·乔·杜佩罗特。”

sentences.en: The captain notified the coast guard of 11-year-old Terry Jo's rescue.
sentences.zh: 船长将11岁的特里·乔获救的消息通知了海岸警卫队。

sentences.en: A helicopter was sent to collect the girl and as she was lifted into a basket, she weakly waved goodbye to the captain Theo's crew.
sentences.zh: 一架直升机被派来接走女孩，当她被吊进吊篮时，她无力地向“西奥船长号”的船员们挥手告别。

sentences.en: Terry Jo was transferred to a hospital in Miami where she was treated for shock and exposure.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔被送往迈阿密的一家医院，在那里接受了休克和暴露治疗。

sentences.en: Exhausted from her 84-hour long ordeal, Terry Jo slept for days.
sentences.zh: 由于84小时的磨难而精疲力竭，特里·乔睡了好几天。

sentences.en: By Sunday November 19, after several days' treatment and rest, she began to appear well again.
sentences.zh: 到了11月19日星期日，经过几天的治疗和休息，她开始好转。

sentences.en: Her room was kept under close guard and her aunt and uncle flew from Green Bay, Wisconsin to be with her.
sentences.zh: 她的病房受到严密看守，她的姑姑和姑父从威斯康星州的格林贝飞来陪伴她。

sentences.en: On Monday November 20, Terry Jo shared her story with the coast guard from her hospital bed.
sentences.zh: 11月20日星期一，特里·乔在病床上向海岸警卫队讲述了她的经历。

sentences.en: Everything had been going well on her family's vacation up until the night of Sunday November 12.
sentences.zh: 在11月12日星期日晚上之前，她家人的度假一切顺利。

sentences.en: That evening, Mary Harvey made everyone chicken cacciatore and salad, which they ate together.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，玛丽·哈维做了猎人炖鸡和沙拉，大家一起吃了晚餐。

sentences.en: At around 9pm, Terry Jo had gone down to the small cabin she shared with her little sister Renee and went to sleep.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点左右，特里·乔下到她和妹妹蕾妮共用的小舱室睡觉去了。

sentences.en: Everyone else had stayed up.
sentences.zh: 其他人都没有睡。

sentences.en: Terry Jo slept deeply until she was suddenly woken by the sound of her brother Brian screaming,
sentences.zh: 特里·乔睡得很沉，直到被哥哥布莱恩的尖叫声惊醒：

sentences.en: Help, Daddy.
sentences.zh: “救命，爸爸。”

sentences.en: Help.
sentences.zh: “救命。”

sentences.en: At the same time, Terry Jo heard the sound of footsteps running and stomping.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，特里·乔听到了奔跑和跺脚的脚步声。

sentences.en: Then, all fell silent, except for a few creaks that were normal for the boat at night.
sentences.zh: 随后，一切归于寂静，只有船只在夜间正常的吱呀声。

sentences.en: Terry Jo lay still in bed, shaking and terrified.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔躺在床上，浑身发抖，惊恐万分。

sentences.en: She waited between 5 and 10 minutes, then got up and slowly crept out to the main cabin.
sentences.zh: 她等了五到十分钟，然后起身慢慢爬向主舱。

sentences.en: Lying on the floor of the main cabin were the bodies of her mother and brother, both in a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 主舱地板上躺着她母亲和哥哥的尸体，都浸在血泊中。

sentences.en: Terry Jo knew they were dead.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔知道他们已经死了。

sentences.en: In shock, she somehow kept moving and walked up the stairs towards the deck.
sentences.zh: 在震惊中，她不知怎地继续移动，走上楼梯朝甲板走去。

sentences.en: She could see more puddles of blood on the starboard side of the cockpit, as well as what looked like a knife.
sentences.zh: 她看到驾驶舱右舷有更多的血迹，还有一把看起来像是刀的东西。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, Captain Julian Harvey appeared and ran towards her.
sentences.zh: 突然，朱利安·哈维船长出现并向她跑来。

sentences.en: Terry Jo started to ask what's happening, when Harvey grabbed her and roughly shoved her back down the stairs, saying,
sentences.zh: 特里·乔刚要问发生了什么事，哈维就抓住她，粗暴地把她推回楼梯下，说道：

sentences.en: Get back down there.
sentences.zh: “滚回下面去。”

sentences.en: Scared and her heart racing, Terry Jo did as she was told, returning to her bunk and huddling in a corner.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔吓坏了，心跳加速，她照做了，回到铺位蜷缩在角落里。

sentences.en: Soon, she heard the sloshing sound of water, followed a few minutes later by water that reeked of oil starting to flood her cabin.
sentences.zh: 很快，她听到了水流声，几分钟后，散发着油味的水开始涌入她的舱室。

sentences.en: Then, Captain Harvey reappeared in the doorway.
sentences.zh: 接着，哈维船长再次出现在门口。

sentences.en: She couldn't see his face due to the shadows of the dark room.
sentences.zh: 由于黑暗房间的阴影，她看不清他的脸。

sentences.en: He was holding something in his hands, which might have been her brother's rifle, but Terry Jo struggled to see.
sentences.zh: 他手里拿着什么东西，可能是她哥哥的步枪，但特里·乔看不真切。

sentences.en: Harvey stood, staring at her for a long time.
sentences.zh: 哈维站着，盯着她看了很久。

sentences.en: Terry Jo sat frozen with fear.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔吓得一动不动。

sentences.en: Finally, Harvey turned around and left.
sentences.zh: 最后，哈维转身离开了。

sentences.en: Some pounding noises followed, and water continued to seep into the cabin, reaching Terry Jo's mattress.
sentences.zh: 随后传来了一些撞击声，水继续渗入舱室，漫到了特里·乔的床垫上。

sentences.en: Terry Jo knew she had to get out.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔知道她必须离开。

sentences.en: The water was up to her waist as she stood and made her way back up the stairs again.
sentences.zh: 当她站起来再次爬上楼梯时，水已经没过她的腰部。

sentences.en: When she reached the cockpit, she saw that the boat's dinghy and black rubber life raft had been launched over the side.
sentences.zh: 当她到达驾驶舱时，看到船上的小艇和黑色橡胶救生筏已经被抛入水中。

sentences.en: Is the ship sinking?
sentences.zh: “船要沉了吗？”

sentences.en: She cried out.
sentences.zh: 她大喊道。

sentences.en: Yes, Harvey answered.
sentences.zh: “是的。”哈维回答。

sentences.en: He was standing behind her, near the front of the boat.
sentences.zh: 他站在她身后，靠近船头。

sentences.en: Then he handed her the line to the dinghy and told her to hold it.
sentences.zh: 然后他把小艇的缆绳递给她，让她抓好。

sentences.en: Terry Jo took the line, and Harvey continued rushing forwards to get something.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔抓住了缆绳，哈维继续匆忙向前去拿什么东西。

sentences.en: As he did so, the line slipped from Terry Jo's fingers.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，缆绳从特里·乔的手指间滑落了。

sentences.en: When he returned mere seconds later, he shouted,
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后他回来时，大喊道：

sentences.en: The dinghy's gone.
sentences.zh: “小艇不见了。”

sentences.en: He then leapt overboard towards the dinghy, which was floating away from the bluebell.
sentences.zh: 随后他跳入水中，朝正在远离“蓝铃号”的小艇游去。

sentences.en: Left all alone, Terry Jo somehow remembered the white cork life float which was kept attached to the top of the main cabin.
sentences.zh: 孤身一人的特里·乔不知怎地想起了系在主舱顶部的白色软木救生浮板。

sentences.en: She retrieved the float by untying the knot that held it in place as the deck beneath her feet slid underwater.
sentences.zh: 当脚下的甲板滑入水下时，她解开了固定浮板的绳结，取下了它。

sentences.en: Then, Terry Jo pushed the life float in front of her while half swimming and half crawling across the main sail, launching the float in the water.
sentences.zh: 然后，特里·乔把救生浮板推到身前，半游半爬地穿过主帆，将浮板推入水中。

sentences.en: The float was so small that Terry Jo couldn't lie down on it.
sentences.zh: 浮板太小了，特里·乔无法躺在上面。

sentences.en: She tried to stay hunched down low, aware that Captain Harvey was out there somewhere in the dark.
sentences.zh: 她试图蜷缩着身体，意识到哈维船长就在黑暗中的某个地方。

sentences.en: She had no food, water or warm clothing and nothing that would allow her to signal for help.
sentences.zh: 她没有食物、水或保暖衣物，也没有任何可以用来求救的东西。

sentences.en: Terry Jo drifted through the water all night, cold and unable to see.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔在水里漂了一整夜，寒冷且什么也看不见。

sentences.en: The wind was howling, and waves periodically washed over her.
sentences.zh: 狂风呼啸，海浪不时拍打在她身上。

sentences.en: When the sun rose the following morning, it helped warm her up.
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨太阳升起时，它帮助她暖和了一些。

sentences.en: But it soon burnt her skin and made her dehydration worse.
sentences.zh: 但很快又灼伤了她的皮肤，加剧了她的脱水。

sentences.en: The cork float she sat on wasn't intended to be kept in the water for long periods of time, and its material beneath her began to disintegrate.
sentences.zh: 她坐的软木浮板本不打算长时间浸泡在水中，她身下的材料开始分解。

sentences.en: This led to parrotfish biting Terry Jo's exposed legs and feet.
sentences.zh: 这导致鹦嘴鱼开始啃咬特里·乔暴露在外的双腿和双脚。

sentences.en: Monday November 13 slowly passed with no help arriving.
sentences.zh: 11月13日星期一在没有救援的情况下缓慢过去。

sentences.en: Terry Jo saw a ship in the distance, but it was too far away to see her.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔在远处看到了一艘船，但距离太远，对方看不见她。

sentences.en: The following day was cloudy and cooler.
sentences.zh: 第二天多云，天气凉爽了一些。

sentences.en: A few aeroplanes flew by, including a small red one that was quite close to her.
sentences.zh: 几架飞机飞过，包括一架离她很近的小红飞机。

sentences.en: It was one of two rescue planes searching for the Bluebell's passengers.
sentences.zh: 那是搜寻“蓝铃号”乘客的两架救援飞机之一。

sentences.en: The red plane flew in a grid pattern above Terry Jo and circled her.
sentences.zh: 红色的飞机在特里·乔上方以网格状飞行并盘旋。

sentences.en: She waved at it frantically, but again went unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 她疯狂地向它挥手，但再次被忽略了。

sentences.en: At one point that afternoon, a pod of pilot whales surfaced about 30 yards from Terry Jo's float and swam alongside her for a time.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，一群领航鲸浮出水面，距离特里·乔的浮板约30码，并陪伴她游了一会儿。

sentences.en: She found comfort in their presence.
sentences.zh: 她从它们的存在中得到了慰藉。

sentences.en: Her sleep that night was plagued by strange hallucinations and dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她的睡眠被奇怪的幻觉和梦境所困扰。

sentences.en: At one point, she saw her father sitting and drinking a glass of red wine.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她看到父亲坐着喝一杯红酒。

sentences.en: He called out to her,
sentences.zh: 他向她喊道：

sentences.en: Come on, Terry Jo.
sentences.zh: “来吧，特里·乔。”

sentences.en: We're leaving now.
sentences.zh: “我们要走了。”

sentences.en: By her third day at sea, Terry Jo was well and truly suffering from heat exhaustion and dehydration.
sentences.zh: 到了海上第三天，特里·乔已经深受热衰竭和脱水之苦。

sentences.en: All of her muscles ached and her lips were rough and swollen.
sentences.zh: 她全身肌肉酸痛，嘴唇粗糙肿胀。

sentences.en: As more of the cork float had broken and disintegrated through the middle, she was restricted to sitting on the edges.
sentences.zh: 由于软木浮板中间部分已经破碎分解，她只能坐在边缘上。

sentences.en: This meant she had to remain upright at all times.
sentences.zh: 这意味着她必须时刻保持坐姿。

sentences.en: Terry Jo began to hallucinate more frequently and it became oblivious to the waves and sea around her.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔开始更频繁地产生幻觉，对周围的海浪和大海变得麻木。

sentences.en: Terry Jo eventually found a way to remain on the float safely and more comfortably.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔最终找到了一种安全且更舒适地待在浮板上的方法。

sentences.en: She rested her shoulders on one edge, her arms on either side, and her thighs on the other edge with her legs in the water.
sentences.zh: 她把肩膀靠在一边，双臂放在两侧，大腿靠在另一边，双腿垂在水里。

sentences.en: By the fourth day, Terry Jo was in a near comatose state.
sentences.zh: 到了第四天，特里·乔处于近乎昏迷的状态。

sentences.en: Her blood pressure had dipped and her temperature soared to 105 degrees Fahrenheit or 40.5 degrees Celsius.
sentences.zh: 她的血压下降，体温飙升至105华氏度（即40.5摄氏度）。

sentences.en: Terry Jo was barely conscious, but at around mid-morning, she suddenly opened her eyes to see the Greek freighter, Captain Theo, looming before her.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔几乎失去了知觉，但在上午中段，她突然睁开眼睛，看到希腊货轮“西奥船长号”出现在眼前。

sentences.en: Terry Jo found the strength to force herself upright and wave at the ship, then paddle towards it.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔找到了力量，强迫自己坐直并向船只挥手，然后向它划去。

sentences.en: She was finally rescued.
sentences.zh: 她终于获救了。

sentences.en: Terry Jo's version of events differed notably from Julian Harvey's.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔对事件的描述与朱利安·哈维的说法有显著差异。

sentences.en: After Coast Guard Captain Robert Barber heard her describe what had happened the night that the bluebell sank,
sentences.zh: 在海岸警卫队罗伯特·巴伯船长听完她描述“蓝铃号”沉没当晚发生的事情后，

sentences.en: he asked the 11-year-old whether she had ever seen a fire at any time on the boat.
sentences.zh: 他问这位11岁的女孩，她在船上是否看到过火灾。

sentences.en: Terry Jo said she hadn't, nor did she see or smell smoke.
sentences.zh: 特里·乔说她没有，也没有看到或闻到烟味。

sentences.en: The Coast Guard investigators were now certain that Julian Harvey had been lying.
sentences.zh: 海岸警卫队的调查人员现在确信朱利安·哈维一直在撒谎。

sentences.en: The bluebell hadn't gone down due to an accident.
sentences.zh: “蓝铃号”并非因事故沉没。

sentences.en: In fact, Terry Jo's descriptions of her mother and brother's bodies, along with the blood she'd seen near the cockpit,
sentences.zh: 事实上，特里·乔对母亲和哥哥遗体的描述，加上她在驾驶舱附近看到的血迹，

sentences.en: made investigators certain that the boat had been deliberately sunk to cover murder.
sentences.zh: 使调查人员确信这艘船是为了掩盖谋杀而蓄意沉没的。

sentences.en: When Captain Harvey received a word of Terry Jo's survival during the Coast Guard hearing, he'd appeared shocked and unsettled.
sentences.zh: 当哈维船长在海岸警卫队听证会上得知特里·乔幸存的消息时，他显得震惊且不安。

sentences.en: After initially expressing his amazement and stating, isn't that wonderful, he then abruptly stood and walked to a nearby window.
sentences.zh: 在最初表达了他的惊讶并说“那不是太好了吗”之后，他突然站起来走到附近的窗前。

sentences.en: After staring outside at the ground below for about a minute, he turned and headed towards the door.
sentences.zh: 盯着窗外地面的景色看了大约一分钟后，他转身朝门口走去。

sentences.en: His employer and the bluebell's owner, Harold Pegg, was still giving his testimony.
sentences.zh: 他的雇主兼“蓝铃号”船主哈罗德·佩格当时仍在作证。

sentences.en: Upon seeing that Harvey appeared to be leaving,
sentences.zh: 当看到哈维似乎要离开时，

sentences.en: Coast Guard Lieutenant Ernest Murdoch asked him,
sentences.zh: 海岸警卫队中尉欧内斯特·默多克问他：

sentences.en: Don't you want to remain for the rest of the testimony?
sentences.zh: “你不想留下来听完剩下的证词吗？”

sentences.en: You have that privilege.
sentences.zh: “你有权这样做。”

sentences.en: Harvey smiled and shook his head, then left.
sentences.zh: 哈维笑了笑，摇了摇头，然后离开了。

sentences.en: Lieutenant Murdoch and his partner, Captain Barber, were suspicious about Harvey's abrupt departure, right after he'd found out Terry Jo survived.
sentences.zh: 默多克中尉和他的搭档巴伯船长对哈维在得知特丽·乔生还后立即离开的行为感到怀疑。

sentences.en: They paused the proceedings to quickly call the Miami Police Department and request that Terry Jo Duperolt's hospital room be kept under constant guard.
sentences.zh: 他们暂停了听证会，迅速致电迈阿密警察局，要求对特丽·乔·杜佩罗特的病房实施全天候看守。

sentences.en: Before his career as a skipper, Julian Harvey had been an Air Force pilot, serving in World War II and the Korean War.
sentences.zh: 在成为船长之前，朱利安·哈维曾是一名空军飞行员，参加过第二次世界大战和朝鲜战争。

sentences.en: His service saw him receive a number of medals.
sentences.zh: 他在服役期间获得过不少勋章。

sentences.en: But his first love had always been sailing.
sentences.zh: 但他最热爱的始终是航海。

sentences.en: As a teenager growing up in New York, he had built sailboats and took them out on the Long Island Sound.
sentences.zh: 少年时期在纽约成长时，他就曾自己建造帆船，并驾驶它们出入长岛海湾。

sentences.en: After he retired from his military career in 1958, he moved to Florida to pursue a full-time career as a master of a yacht.
sentences.zh: 1958年从军旅生涯退役后，他搬到佛罗里达，开始全职从事游艇船长的工作。

sentences.en: People in Fort Lauderdale regarded him as a handsome and dashing war hero.
sentences.zh: 劳德代尔堡的人们视他为一位英俊潇洒的战争英雄。

sentences.en: In July 1961, Julian Harvey married aspiring writer Mary Jordan, who was ten years his junior.
sentences.zh: 1961年7月，朱利安·哈维娶了比他小十岁的有志作家玛丽·乔丹。

sentences.en: Mary wasn't Harvey's first wife.
sentences.zh: 玛丽并非哈维的第一任妻子。

sentences.en: He had been married five times before and was known to be unfaithful to his spouses.
sentences.zh: 他之前结过五次婚，且以对配偶不忠而闻名。

sentences.en: Some of his marriages ended with Harvey telling his wives he no longer loved them, but more than one ended in tragedy.
sentences.zh: 他的一些婚姻以哈维告诉妻子不再爱她们而告终，但其中不止一段婚姻以悲剧收场。

sentences.en: In 1949, when Harvey was 32, he was driving along a rainy highway with his second wife, Joan Boylan, and her mother Myrtle, when his car skidded into a bridge railing,
sentences.zh: 1949年，32岁的哈维正载着第二任妻子琼·博伊兰和她的母亲默特尔在雨中的公路上行驶，车子突然打滑撞上了桥栏，

sentences.en: then sunk into a bayou.
sentences.zh: 随后沉入河湾。

sentences.en: Joan and Myrtle both drowned, trapped in the car.
sentences.zh: 琼和默特尔都被困在车内溺亡。

sentences.en: Harvey walked away unharmed.
sentences.zh: 哈维却毫发无损地逃脱了。

sentences.en: He attributed this to the fact he'd seen the accident coming at the last second, prompting him to open his door and jump out before the collision.
sentences.zh: 他将此归功于自己在最后一秒预见到了事故，促使他在碰撞前打开车门跳了出去。

sentences.en: He made no attempt to save his wife or mother-in-law.
sentences.zh: 他没有尝试去救自己的妻子或岳母。

sentences.en: Bypassers who came across the accident saw him standing on the bridge calmly, watching others diving into the water.
sentences.zh: 路过的行人看到他冷静地站在桥上，看着别人潜入水中救援。

sentences.en: A highway patrol officer and the police diver who responded to the incident were suspicious, especially when the car was found with all four doors closed
sentences.zh: 一名公路巡警和负责处理此事的警队潜水员对此表示怀疑，尤其是当发现车子的四扇车门全部关闭，

sentences.en: and the driver's side window wound down.
sentences.zh: 且驾驶座一侧的车窗是摇下的。

sentences.en: But there was no hard evidence indicating a crime and Harvey was permitted to move on with his life.
sentences.zh: 但由于没有确凿证据表明存在犯罪，哈维得以继续他的生活。

sentences.en: He received a payout from a life insurance policy he'd taken out on Joan and within weeks of her death, he was living with another woman.
sentences.zh: 他获得了为琼投保的人寿保险赔偿金，并在她死后几周内就与另一名女性同居了。

sentences.en: In 1954, Harvey and his fifth wife purchased a 68-foot yacht called the Torbatross.
sentences.zh: 1954年，哈维和他的第五任妻子购买了一艘68英尺长的游艇，名为“托巴特罗斯号”。

sentences.en: Within a year of buying it, Harvey and several friends took it out one day and rammed it into a submerged battleship.
sentences.zh: 买下它不到一年，哈维和几位朋友有一天驾驶它撞上了一艘沉没的战舰。

sentences.en: The Torbatross sank, but all on board survived, with Harvey suing the US government due to the submerged wreck causing the accident.
sentences.zh: “托巴特罗斯号”沉没了，但船上所有人都幸存了下来，哈维还因沉船导致事故而起诉了美国政府。

sentences.en: Coast Guard investigator Robert Barber, who was assigned this case six years before the bluebell sank, believed Harvey had deliberately run into the wreck.
sentences.zh: 在“蓝铃号”沉没六年前就负责此案的海岸警卫队调查员罗伯特·巴伯认为，哈维是故意撞向沉船的。

sentences.en: It was a well-known navigational hazard that was clearly marked with a buoy and its exact location was clearly visible.
sentences.zh: 那是一个众所周知的航行危险点，有明显的浮标标记，其确切位置清晰可见。

sentences.en: Furthermore, a passenger who'd been on the yacht said Harvey had circled the wreck twice before the collision.
sentences.zh: 此外，一名曾在那艘游艇上的乘客表示，哈维在碰撞前曾绕着沉船转了两圈。

sentences.en: Ultimately, the court found differently and awarded Harvey a $14,258 payout.
sentences.zh: 最终，法院做出了不同的裁决，判给哈维14258美元的赔偿金。

sentences.en: Using the proceeds of this settlement, Harvey bought another boat, an 81-foot yacht called Valiant.
sentences.zh: 利用这笔和解金，哈维买了另一艘船，一艘81英尺长的游艇，名为“英勇号”。

sentences.en: In 1958, the Valiant was spotted on fire in the marina where it was kept.
sentences.zh: 1958年，“英勇号”在停泊的码头被发现起火。

sentences.en: A passer-by was able to douse the flames and the boat was saved.
sentences.zh: 一名路人及时扑灭了火焰，船只得以保全。

sentences.en: A few months later, Harvey sailed the Valiant to Cuba.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，哈维驾驶“英勇号”前往古巴。

sentences.en: When he was 10 miles off the north coast of Cuba, the yacht caught fire.
sentences.zh: 当他航行至古巴北海岸10英里处时，游艇起火了。

sentences.en: Harvey and his sole crewmen were able to escape as the Valiant burnt and sank.
sentences.zh: 哈维和唯一的船员在“英勇号”燃烧沉没时成功逃生。

sentences.en: A passing boat picked up Harvey and he was able to collect a $40,000 insurance payout for losing his second boat.
sentences.zh: 一艘路过的船只救起了哈维，他因此获得了4万美元的保险赔偿，以弥补他损失的第二艘船。

sentences.en: Some were suspicious due to the earlier fire on the Valiant, and a friend of Harvey's later told author Richard Logan that Harvey had told him
sentences.zh: 由于“英勇号”之前发生过火灾，有些人对此表示怀疑，哈维的一位朋友后来告诉作家理查德·洛根，哈维曾告诉他，

sentences.en: he'd burned and sank the yacht because he needed the money.
sentences.zh: 他烧毁并沉没了那艘游艇，因为他需要钱。

sentences.en: In the fall of 1960, Julian Harvey met a flight attendant and aspiring writer named Mary Jordan while he was skippering a yacht that had been chartered for a party.
sentences.zh: 1960年秋，朱利安·哈维在担任一艘包租游艇的船长时，结识了一位空姐兼有志作家玛丽·乔丹。

sentences.en: Mary and Harvey hit it off and were married in Mexico in July 1961.
sentences.zh: 玛丽和哈维一见钟情，并于1961年7月在墨西哥结婚。

sentences.en: The pair soon began arguing frequently, often about money.
sentences.zh: 两人很快开始频繁争吵，通常都是为了钱。

sentences.en: Mary's father was unwell, so she promised to send her family $25 per month to help pay for his hospital care.
sentences.zh: 玛丽的父亲身体不好，所以她承诺每月寄给家人25美元，以帮助支付他的住院费用。

sentences.en: Harvey was unhappy about this.
sentences.zh: 哈维对此很不高兴。

sentences.en: Two months after their wedding, he took out a $20,000 life insurance policy on his new wife.
sentences.zh: 婚后两个月，他为新婚妻子购买了一份2万美元的人寿保险。

sentences.en: The policy included a double indemnity clause that meant if she died in an accident and her body wasn't recovered, he would receive $40,000.
sentences.zh: 该保单包含双倍赔偿条款，意味着如果她死于事故且尸体未被寻获，他将获得4万美元。

sentences.en: One month before the Duperolt family arrived in Florida, the Blue Bell's owner Harold Pegg hired Julian Harvey as a skipper.
sentences.zh: 在杜佩罗特一家抵达佛罗里达前一个月，“蓝铃号”船主哈罗德·佩格聘请了朱利安·哈维担任船长。

sentences.en: Harvey would receive $300 per month as well as free accommodation on the catch in exchange for taking tourists out on chartered cruises.
sentences.zh: 作为带游客进行包租巡航的交换，哈维每月可获得300美元的报酬，并可在双桅帆船上免费住宿。

sentences.en: The Duperolts had been the first clients that Harvey had taken out.
sentences.zh: 杜佩罗特一家是哈维带出的第一批客户。

sentences.en: After Terry Jo was rescued, her description of what had happened on Sunday November 12 pointed to a violent attack caused by a person, not a weather event.
sentences.zh: 特丽·乔获救后，她对11月12日星期日所发生之事的描述，指向了一场由人为而非天气引发的暴力袭击。

sentences.en: And a number of people had noticed holes and inconsistencies in Harvey's story from the start.
sentences.zh: 而且从一开始，就有不少人注意到了哈维陈述中的漏洞和前后矛盾之处。

sentences.en: While most of the crew from the Gulf Lion who'd rescued Harvey empathised with him, others were suspicious of him.
sentences.zh: 虽然救起哈维的“海狮号”船员大多对他表示同情，但其他人却对他心存怀疑。

sentences.en: Some found his demeanour odd, noting that he was joking and laughing, despite his ordeal and the presence of seven-year-old
sentences.zh: 有些人觉得他的举止古怪，注意到尽管经历了磨难，且现场还有七岁的

sentences.en: Renee Duperolt's body.
sentences.zh: 蕾妮·杜佩罗特的尸体，他却还在开玩笑和大笑。

sentences.en: They heard Harvey tell their captain that he didn't know what happened to his wife.
sentences.zh: 他们听到哈维告诉船长，他不知道妻子发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Then later he amended his story when talking to the crew, saying he had seen
sentences.zh: 后来在与船员交谈时，他又修改了说法，称自己看到

sentences.en: Mary jump overboard.
sentences.zh: 玛丽跳海了。

sentences.en: Harvey had also initially told the Gulf Lion's crew that Arthur and Jean Duperolt had been killed instantly when they were struck by the falling maSt. Yet, at the hearing several
sentences.zh: 哈维最初还告诉“海狮号”船员，亚瑟和琼·杜佩罗特在被倒下的桅杆击中时当场死亡。然而，在几天后的听证会上，

sentences.en: days later, he said only that some passengers had been injured.
sentences.zh: 他却只说有几名乘客受了伤。

sentences.en: The Coast Guard investigators noted some contradictions too.
sentences.zh: 海岸警卫队的调查人员也注意到了其中的一些矛盾。

sentences.en: They found Harvey's story of a fire unlikely.
sentences.zh: 他们认为哈维关于火灾的说法不太可信。

sentences.en: There was a lighthouse stationed just a few miles from where the bluebell sank, yet the lookout there hadn't seen any flames.
sentences.zh: 在“蓝铃号”沉没地点仅几英里外就有一座灯塔，但那里的瞭望员并没有看到任何火光。

sentences.en: And Harvey's description of how the broken mast plunged directly down into the boat's deck wasn't consistent with what they'd seen in similar circumstances.
sentences.zh: 而且哈维描述断裂的桅杆直接坠入船甲板的情况，与他们在类似情况下所见的不符。

sentences.en: If a mast was broken by heavy wind, it tended to fall sideways and overboard.
sentences.zh: 如果桅杆被大风吹断，它通常会向侧面倾倒并落入海中。

sentences.en: Then there was the fact that Harvey hadn't used the flares in the dinghy's emergency kit to signal for
sentences.zh: 此外，哈维并没有使用救生艇应急包里的信号弹来求救，

sentences.en: help, supposedly because he either forgot about them or couldn't be bothered rummaging through the back.
sentences.zh: 据称是因为他要么忘了，要么懒得去翻找。

sentences.en: Following extensive interviews and investigations, the Coast Guard officers in charge of the Bluebell case put together a theory.
sentences.zh: 经过广泛的访谈和调查，负责“蓝铃号”案件的海岸警卫队官员整理出了一套理论。

sentences.en: They suspected that Julian Harvey had intended to kill his wife Mary while out at sea and dispose of her body overboard, with the aim of collecting the life insurance payout.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑朱利安·哈维打算在海上杀害妻子玛丽，并将她的尸体抛入海中，目的是骗取人寿保险赔偿。

sentences.en: Harold Pegg had noticed scratches on Harvey's arm after he was rescued.
sentences.zh: 哈维获救后，哈罗德·佩格曾注意到他手臂上有抓痕。

sentences.en: Harvey said they were from scrambling through the rigging after the yacht's mast broke.
sentences.zh: 哈维称那是游艇桅杆断裂后，他在索具中挣扎时留下的。

sentences.en: But Harold was adamant that the scratches were clearly made by fingernails, and Mary had had long nails.
sentences.zh: 但哈罗德坚称那些抓痕显然是指甲抓出来的，而玛丽留着长指甲。

sentences.en: Investigators thought Harvey had probably stabbed Mary in their shared cabin, and she fought back.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为哈维很可能在他们的共用船舱里刺伤了玛丽，而她进行了反抗。

sentences.en: His plan was likely to later throw her body overboard when everyone else was asleep, and discover her missing the following morning.
sentences.zh: 他的计划很可能是等大家都睡着后将她的尸体抛入海中，然后在第二天早上发现她失踪。

sentences.en: The Coast Guard investigators believed that Harvey hadn't intended for the Duperolt family to die, or the Bluebell to sink.
sentences.zh: 海岸警卫队调查人员认为，哈维本无意让杜佩罗特一家死亡，也不想让“蓝铃号”沉没。

sentences.en: But perhaps Arthur Duperolt had come across Harvey while he was either murdering Mary or disposing of her body.
sentences.zh: 但或许亚瑟·杜佩罗特在哈维谋杀玛丽或处理尸体时撞见了这一切。

sentences.en: To cover up his crime, Harvey killed Arthur and then Jean Duperolt, who might have also been a witness.
sentences.zh: 为了掩盖罪行，哈维杀害了亚瑟，随后又杀害了可能也是目击者的琼·杜佩罗特。

sentences.en: The noise woke Brian Duperolt, who cried out for his father.
sentences.zh: 响声惊醒了布莱恩·杜佩罗特，他大声呼喊父亲。

sentences.en: Harvey killed him, too.
sentences.zh: 哈维也杀了他。

sentences.en: Terry Jo had spotted the bodies of her mother and brother lying dead on the floor, but hadn't seen anyone else.
sentences.zh: 特丽·乔曾看到母亲和哥哥的尸体躺在地板上，但没有看到其他人。

sentences.en: Because she had been sleeping downstairs, Terry Jo was initially left to drown as Harvey
sentences.zh: 因为她当时睡在楼下，特丽·乔最初被留在那儿等死，而哈维

sentences.en: scrambled to sink the catch so that the mass murder would instead look like a terrible accident.
sentences.zh: 忙着弄沉帆船，好让这起大规模谋杀看起来像是一场可怕的事故。

sentences.en: When she went upstairs and interrupted Harvey, it appeared he had considered killing her, too.
sentences.zh: 当她走到楼上撞见哈维时，他似乎也动了杀心。

sentences.en: He subsequently appeared in her doorway, apparently carrying her brother's rifle.
sentences.zh: 随后他出现在她的门口，手里似乎拿着她哥哥的步枪。

sentences.en: Ultimately, he hadn't shot her, as he'd decided she would drown anyway with the catch sinking.
sentences.zh: 最终，他没有开枪，因为他认定随着帆船沉没，她无论如何都会淹死。

sentences.en: An autopsy indicated Renee Duperolt had drowned, but couldn't determine if this had been done intentionally by another person, or was the result of the Bluebell sinking.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示蕾妮·杜佩罗特死于溺水，但无法确定这是他人蓄意为之，还是“蓝铃号”沉没的结果。

sentences.en: Investigators suspected her mother Jean might have tried to shield her during the attack,
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑她的母亲琼在袭击过程中可能试图保护她，

sentences.en: and in the process of Jean's murder, Renee was struck or hit her head, falling unconscious.
sentences.zh: 而在杀害琼的过程中，蕾妮被击中或头部受撞击而昏迷。

sentences.en: She subsequently drowned when the Bluebell went under, and Harvey retrieved her floating body to bolster his story.
sentences.zh: 随后在“蓝铃号”沉没时她溺水身亡，哈维捞起了她漂浮的尸体以支撑他的谎言。

sentences.en: Investigators believed that Harvey hadn't used the emergency kit flares to signal for help, because he didn't want to be found too close to the site where the Bluebell sank.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，哈维没有使用应急包里的信号弹求救，是因为他不想被发现离“蓝铃号”沉没地点太近。

sentences.en: If the wreckage was recovered, evidence on board might have disproved his claims about what happened.
sentences.zh: 如果残骸被捞起，船上的证据可能会推翻他关于事发经过的说法。

sentences.en: The Bluebell was never found, and nor were the bodies of the four other victiMs.
sentences.zh: “蓝铃号”从未被找到，其他四名受害者的遗体也下落不明。

sentences.en: Captain Harvey's demeanour throughout the Coast Guard hearing had been interesting.
sentences.zh: 哈维船长在整个海岸警卫队听证会上的表现很有意思。

sentences.en: He was obviously nervous and stammered often.
sentences.zh: 他显然很紧张，经常结巴。

sentences.en: He became even more uncomfortable after it was announced that Terry-Jo Duperolt had been found alive, abruptly leaving the hearing without explanation.
sentences.zh: 在宣布特丽·乔·杜佩罗特被发现生还后，他变得更加不安，并毫无解释地突然离开了听证会。

sentences.en: Just before noon on Friday November 17, the day after Harvey left the hearing, a cleaner at Miami's Sandman Motel knocked on the door of room 17.
sentences.zh: 11月17日星期五中午前，也就是哈维离开听证会的第二天，迈阿密沙人汽车旅馆的一名清洁工敲响了17号房的门。

sentences.en: A man named John Munro had booked the room for one night the previous day.
sentences.zh: 一名叫约翰·芒罗的男子前一天预订了该房间一晚。

sentences.en: It was just before checkout time, and she needed to make up the room.
sentences.zh: 当时快到退房时间了，她需要打扫房间。

sentences.en: When there was no response from inside, the cleaner unlocked the door and let herself in.
sentences.zh: 由于屋内没有回应，清洁工打开门走了进去。

sentences.en: She was met by a blast of cool air from the air conditioner, which had been left on.
sentences.zh: 一阵冷气扑面而来，空调一直开着。

sentences.en: The breeze was pleasant due to the stifling Miami heat outside.
sentences.zh: 由于迈阿密室外闷热难耐，这阵凉风倒还算舒适。

sentences.en: But the cleaner also noticed a slightly strange smell.
sentences.zh: 但清洁工也闻到了一股略显奇怪的味道。

sentences.en: She thought little of it and set about doing her job.
sentences.zh: 她没多想，便开始干活。

sentences.en: The room had two twin beds, and the cleaner began to strip the sheets from one.
sentences.zh: 房间里有两张单人床，清洁工开始拆卸其中一张床的床单。

sentences.en: When she pulled back the covers, she noticed one of the sheets had a small patch of blood on it.
sentences.zh: 当她掀开被子时，注意到其中一张床单上有一小块血迹。

sentences.en: She then went to the bathroom to gather the towels.
sentences.zh: 随后她去浴室收集毛巾。

sentences.en: The door was closed, and when she tried to open it, the handle moved, but the door wouldn't open.
sentences.zh: 门是关着的，当她试图打开时，把手动了，但门打不开。

sentences.en: The cleaner could tell there was something pushed up against its other side.
sentences.zh: 清洁工能感觉到门后有什么东西顶着。

sentences.en: It felt like something large and soft.
sentences.zh: 感觉像是什么又大又软的东西。

sentences.en: She noticed that the strange odour she'd smelt was also stronger in this part of the room.
sentences.zh: 她注意到刚才闻到的那股怪味在房间的这个区域更浓了。

sentences.en: Suddenly realising that what she could smell was blood, she began to scream.
sentences.zh: 突然意识到那股味道是血腥味，她开始尖叫起来。

sentences.en: The hotel manager was summoned by the commotion, and he too tried to open the bathroom door.
sentences.zh: 旅馆经理被骚动引来，他也试图打开浴室门。

sentences.en: When he couldn't push it open, he called the police.
sentences.zh: 当他推不开门时，便报了警。

sentences.en: A patrol officer arrived at the scene at 12.14pm and was able to force the door partially open by using his shoulder.
sentences.zh: 一名巡警于下午12点14分到达现场，用肩膀撞开了门的一条缝。

sentences.en: Sticking his head in the open space, he saw the body of a man lying on the floor, covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 他探头往里看，发现一名男子倒在地上，浑身是血。

sentences.en: The officer had previously worked at the Miami Harbour and recognised the man as Bluebell Captain, Julian Harvey.
sentences.zh: 这名警官曾在迈阿密港工作过，认出那人正是“蓝铃号”船长朱利安·哈维。

sentences.en: Investigators were able to piece together Harvey's movements after leaving Coast Guard headquarters the day prior.
sentences.zh: 调查人员拼凑出了哈维离开海岸警卫队总部后的行踪。

sentences.en: He had retrieved a suitcase from his car, which was parked nearby, then caught a cab to the Sandman Motel.
sentences.zh: 他从停在附近的汽车里取出一个手提箱，然后打车去了沙人汽车旅馆。

sentences.en: At 11am, he checked in using the false name of John Munro and said he was from Tampa.
sentences.zh: 上午11点，他用假名约翰·芒罗登记入住，并称自己来自坦帕。

sentences.en: After going to his room, he hadn't been seen again.
sentences.zh: 进入房间后，就再也没人见过他。

sentences.en: On a desk inside Harvey's motel room, investigators found a letter he had written to a friend.
sentences.zh: 在哈维旅馆房间的桌子上，调查人员发现了他写给朋友的一封信。

sentences.en: He mentioned nothing about the Bluebell or what had happened to it, but wrote,
sentences.zh: 信中只字未提“蓝铃号”或其遭遇，但写道：

sentences.en: I'm a nervous wreck and just can't continue.
sentences.zh: “我精神崩溃了，实在无法再继续下去。”

sentences.en: I'm going out now.
sentences.zh: “我现在要走了。”

sentences.en: I guess I either don't like life or don't know what to do with it.
sentences.zh: “我想我要么是不喜欢生活，要么是不知道该拿它怎么办。”

sentences.en: After sealing the envelope, he wrote on it, cremate and bury at sea, before scribbling over the word cremate.
sentences.zh: 封好信封后，他在上面写下“火化并海葬”，随后又涂掉了“火化”二字。

sentences.en: Harvey had unpacked his suitcase, hung up his clothes and left his suitcase on the luggage rack.
sentences.zh: 哈维打开了手提箱，挂好了衣服，把箱子留在了行李架上。

sentences.en: He pinned a $10 note to his pillow as a tip for the cleaner.
sentences.zh: 他在枕头上别了一张10美元的钞票，作为给清洁工的小费。

sentences.en: The blood on the bed suggested he'd first tried to suicide there before getting up and moving to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 床上的血迹表明他最初试图在那里自杀，之后才起身移到浴室。

sentences.en: He'd taken two photographs with him, one of his wife Mary and the other of his son from a previous relationship.
sentences.zh: 他随身带了两张照片，一张是他妻子玛丽的，另一张是他与前任关系中所生儿子的。

sentences.en: These photos were found propped up on the toilet tank and were visible from the spot on the floor where Harvey died.
sentences.zh: 这些照片被发现立在马桶水箱上，从哈维死亡的地板位置可以看见。

sentences.en: He had used a razor blade to make multiple cuts in numerous places all over his body until he eventually bled out.
sentences.zh: 他用剃须刀片在全身多处割了许多刀，直到最终失血过多而死。

sentences.en: Investigators were struck by the brutality of the scene.
sentences.zh: 调查人员被现场的惨状所震惊。

sentences.en: Harvey had been left mutilated by his many injuries.
sentences.zh: 哈维因多处伤口而变得面目全非。

sentences.en: Friends suspected he had been left devastated and guilt-ridden by the mass casualties on the Bluebell, including the loss of his wife.
sentences.zh: 朋友们怀疑他因“蓝铃号”上的重大伤亡，包括妻子的离世，而感到悲痛欲绝、愧疚难当。

sentences.en: But this theory fell apart several days later when Terry-Jo Duperault was finally well enough to tell her story.
sentences.zh: 但这一理论在几天后，当特丽·乔·杜佩罗特终于康复并讲述她的故事时，便不攻自破了。

sentences.en: Because Harvey had taken his own life before investigators had a chance to arrest him,
sentences.zh: 由于哈维在调查人员有机会逮捕他之前就自杀了，

sentences.en: no one would ever answer for what happened to the Bluebell and its passengers in a court of law.
sentences.zh: “蓝铃号”及其乘客的遭遇将永远无法在法庭上得到交代。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, April 25, 1962, the Coast Guard issued a detailed statement following a five-month-long investigation.
sentences.zh: 1962年4月25日星期三，海岸警卫队在经过五个月的调查后发布了一份详细声明。

sentences.en: They concluded that Captain Julian Harvey murdered his wife and three members of the Duperault family before scuttling the Bluebell.
sentences.zh: 他们断定朱利安·哈维船长在凿沉“蓝铃号”之前，杀害了他的妻子和杜佩罗特一家的三名成员。

sentences.en: The miraculous survival of Terry-Jo Duperault was deemed to have been aided by several factors,
sentences.zh: 特丽·乔·杜佩罗特的奇迹生还被认为得益于几个因素，

sentences.en: including mild weather and the fact that a slick of oil from the sunken catch had enveloped the water around her life float, deterring predators such as sharks.
sentences.zh: 包括温和的天气，以及沉船溢出的油污覆盖了她救生浮具周围的水面，从而阻挡了鲨鱼等掠食者。

sentences.en: Terry-Jo was also an outdoorsy child.
sentences.zh: 特丽·乔也是个喜欢户外活动的孩子。

sentences.en: At home in Wisconsin, she had played survival-themed games by herself in the woods that had in some small way prepared her for the plight she later faced.
sentences.zh: 在威斯康星州的家中，她曾独自在树林里玩过生存主题的游戏，这在某种程度上为她后来面临的困境做了一点准备。

sentences.en: Terry-Jo's ordeal led to the Coast Guard mandating that life rafts be bright orange instead of white to make them easier to spot amongst the ocean's whitecaps.
sentences.zh: 特丽·乔的遭遇促使海岸警卫队规定救生筏必须使用亮橙色而非白色，以便在海面的浪花中更容易被发现。

sentences.en: After her recovery in hospital, Terry-Jo returned home to Green Bay, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 在医院康复后，特丽-乔回到了威斯康星州绿湾的家中。

sentences.en: She was raised by her aunt and uncle alongside her three cousins.
sentences.zh: 她由姑姑和姑父抚养长大，和三个表亲生活在一起。

sentences.en: People from all over the world who had been touched by her story sent her letters and gifts.
sentences.zh: 世界各地被她故事打动的人们纷纷寄来信件和礼物。

sentences.en: The crew of the Captain Theo, the freighter that rescued her, even bought Terry-Jo a life-sized doll after learning she'd lost one similar in the tragedy.
sentences.zh: 救起她的货轮“西奥船长号”的船员们，在得知她在悲剧中丢失了一个玩偶后，甚至特意为她买了一个真人大小的玩偶。

sentences.en: When she was 12 years old, she changed her name to Terry, spelled T-E-R-E.
sentences.zh: 12岁那年，她把名字改成了特丽（Terry），拼写为T-E-R-E。

sentences.en: She wanted to escape the name that was inextricably tied with an infamous crime and move beyond being seen as a victim.
sentences.zh: 她想摆脱那个与恶名昭彰的罪行紧密相连的名字，不再仅仅被视为一名受害者。

sentences.en: Changing her name allowed her to reclaim her identity and take some control back.
sentences.zh: 改名让她得以重拾自我，并夺回了一些生活的主动权。

sentences.en: Those around Terry never brought up the tragedy of what had happened to her family, so she learnt to avoid the subject as well.
sentences.zh: 特丽身边的人从不提起她家人遭遇的悲剧，于是她也学会了回避这个话题。

sentences.en: Almost two decades went by before Terry spoke about it.
sentences.zh: 近二十年过去了，特丽才第一次开口谈及往事。

sentences.en: She married and had children without ever having opened up about her trauma.
sentences.zh: 她结婚生子，却始终没有敞开心扉谈论过自己的创伤。

sentences.en: Eventually, she told a doctor what had happened, which gradually led to her being able to discuss it more openly.
sentences.zh: 最终，她向一位医生讲述了当年的经历，这让她逐渐能够更坦然地讨论这件事。

sentences.en: Sharing her story made her feel lighter, and eventually she co-wrote a book about the tragedy with survival expert Richard Logan.
sentences.zh: 分享自己的故事让她感到如释重负，后来她与生存专家理查德·洛根合著了一本关于这场悲剧的书。

sentences.en: Titled Alone, Orphaned on the Ocean, the book is a detailed account of the crime, the subsequent events, and Terry's life after.
sentences.zh: 这本书名为《孤独：大洋上的孤儿》，详细记录了那场罪行、后续事件以及特丽之后的生活。

sentences.en: In an interview about the book's publication with CBS News,
sentences.zh: 在接受哥伦比亚广播公司新闻部关于新书出版的采访时，

sentences.en: Terry revealed that ever since what happened on the Bluebell, she has felt intuitively drawn to the water, and even pursued a career in water resources.
sentences.zh: 特丽透露，自从“蓝铃号”事件发生后，她就感到自己与水有一种直觉上的联系，甚至还从事了水资源方面的工作。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 她说：

sentences.en: Julian Harvey abandoned me thinking the ocean would swallow me, but instead it created a bond between me and water.
sentences.zh: 朱利安·哈维抛弃了我，以为大海会吞噬我，但大海反而在我与水之间建立了一种纽带。

sentences.en: In our book, I describe what it was like to be dependent on the water for the four days I waited to be rescued.
sentences.zh: 在书中，我描述了在等待救援的那四天里，完全依赖水生存是什么样的感觉。

sentences.en: I write about the ocean life around me and the power of that experience.
sentences.zh: 我写到了身边的海洋生物，以及那段经历带给我的力量。

sentences.en: I went on to protect the water that had protected me as a little girl.
sentences.zh: 我后来投身于保护水资源的工作，正是这些水在小时候保护了我。

sentences.en: Water is life and it is soothing for me to be on the beach.
sentences.zh: 水就是生命，待在海滩上让我感到平静。

sentences.en: I find I can think clearly, relax, and feel closer to my lost family.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己能在那儿理清思绪、放松身心，并感觉离我失去的家人更近了一些。

sentences.en: Reflecting on the message she wanted to share with readers, Terry stated,
sentences.zh: 在谈到她想传达给读者的信息时，特丽表示：

sentences.en: I always believed I was saved for a reason, but it took me 50 years to gain the strength to be able to give other people hope with my story.
sentences.zh: 我一直相信我获救是有原因的，但我花了50年才积攒起足够的力量，用我的故事给他人带去希望。

sentences.en: If just one person goes on to heal from a life tragedy, my journey will have been worth it.
sentences.zh: 如果能有一个人因为我的故事而从人生悲剧中走出来，那么我所经历的一切都是值得的。

sentences.en: I am a survivor trying to reach other survivors.
sentences.zh: 我是一名幸存者，正努力去触及其他的幸存者。

sentences.en: It took me so long, but I want people to understand that there is no timeline with healing.
sentences.zh: 我花了这么久才做到，但我希望人们明白，疗愈没有时间表。

sentences.en: It is never too late.
sentences.zh: 永远都不算太晚。
